spanish: Y tomó el becerro que hicieron, y lo quemó en el fuego, y lo molió hasta fino, y esparció sobre faz de las aguas, e hizo beber a hijos de Israel.

findings.issue: «lo» is an unmarked supplied object. The burn verb has no object suffix or object noun, so the pronoun resolves the ellipsis by identifying the calf as what was burned.
«lo» is an unmarked supplied object. The grind verb has no object suffix or object noun, so the pronoun resolves the ellipsis by identifying the calf as what was ground.
עַד אֲשֶׁר plus qal perfect 3ms is a finite clause. «hasta fino» drops the relative and renders that verb as an adjective.
Plural construct פני is smoothed to singular faz; the sense remains one face or surface.

notes: 3ms sequence, 3cp hicieron, en el fuego, hiphil hizo beber, and hijos de Israel stay inside the tokens.
